software_class: security, operations, compliance, audit, or risk workflow assistant

options.name: Audit evidence workflow
options.when_to_use: Evidence collection and review are central.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when realtime operations are primary.
options.risks: Evidence can become stale without ownership.

options.name: SecOps assistant
options.when_to_use: Operators need triage, enrichment, or guided response.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when actions cannot be safely bounded.
options.rationale: Improves response consistency with human control.
options.risks: Unsafe automation can create operational risk.

options.name: Policy-as-code gate
options.when_to_use: Controls must run automatically against artifacts.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when policy is not formalized.
